Step 1: Use n×log(a) = log(a^n)
Step 2: 2log(5) = log(5^2)
Answer: log(25)

questions.question: Express log_9(19) in terms of natural logarithm
questions.solution:
Step 1: Use change of base formula: log_a(x) = ln(x)/ln(a)
Step 2: log_9(19) = ln(19)/ln(9)
Answer: ln(19)/ln(9)

Answer: x = 3
